faqs.q: How much more home can I get if I don’t have a $250 car payment?
faqs.a: A $250 car payment equates to about a $50,000 mortgage. Not many people are buying houses for $50,000, but what this really means is you can add this to your potential home buying power, your purchasing power. So, with the car payment of $250, you can afford a $200,000 house, but without that $250 car payment, you could afford a $250,000 house. And today, that’s a big deal.

faqs.q: How much more home can I get if I don’t have a $400 car payment?
faqs.a: If your car payment is $400 a month, that equates to roughly $90,000 that could go into buying a new home.

faqs.q: How much more home can I get if I don’t have a $600 car payment?
faqs.a: If your car payment is $600 a month, that equates to roughly $140,000 that could go into buying a new home.

faqs.q: How much more home can I get if I don’t have a $1000 car payment?
faqs.a: If your car payment is $1000 a month, that equates to roughly $235,000 that could go into buying a new home.
